answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. The fable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the beacon. What survives to the haven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
